pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are building a recommendation system for a large e-commerce platform that serves 50 million active users. The system needs to generate personalized product rankings in under 100 milliseconds at request time. Walk through your end-to-end architecture: how do you generate candidate items, how do you rank them, where do you store and serve user and item features, and how do you handle the cold-start problem for new users and new products? What are the biggest bottlenecks in your design and how do you address them?
